data.reason_zh: 学习可复用探索策略，由回放反馈选择并跨COP迁移，属于控制流/改进器级持续改进。

scope_support.feedback_quote: policy replay provides feedback on the quality of the programs revealed and the search steps used, to guide policy selection more effectively.
scope_support.object_quote: a \emph{policy agent} learns executable policies through \emph{dreaming} in this experience world to guide a \emph{discovery agent} in generating and refining COP programs.
scope_support.persistence_quote: the learned exploration policies transfer effectively across different COPs with the assitance of the experience world.
